chat.t: Hello. I am Bianca of Celestial.
I contacted you because there is something I would like to ask. Do you have a moment?

o: Ah, that Celestial girl who sliced my door in half before?

chat.t: Ahem... Please forget about that...

o: I'll think about it
But if you're wearing a blindfold, you shouldn't be able to see. How are you using MochiTalk?
Do you take off your blindfold when looking at your Quartz or something?

chat.t: I have not taken off my blindfold. I am using MochiTalk through its voice recognition feature.

o: Tch. You're no fun
So, what's this about?

chat.t: I contacted you because I am interested in your abilities as a Fixer.
Rumor has it that you are... a strangely capable Fixer, yet someone people feel hesitant to hire.

o: I am pretty special, after all.

chat.t: There are also rumors about you being a naked Fixer.

o: Can you forget about that? It's totally made up
Anyway, just let me know where to meet

chat.t: It is not that I am worried, but...
Will you be able to find the Apostate with only the information I provided?

o: Honestly speaking, it's not enough
But even if I lack luck, I've got real skill
It'll work out somehow, won't it?

chat.t: It is good to see that you are confident.
I shall place my trust in you and await your news.

lines.t: Inside Celestial Cathedral
So this is Celestial Cathedral's chapel...

It looks just like a club party people would love, but is it not open yet?
There's no one here.
Report on your progress.

I-I am sorry, Mother Superior...
We have not yet uncovered the identities of the Apostates...
I understand since you are sisters who have not even completed your Postulancy, but...
If the investigation drags on like this, it will be difficult for me to advance your Perpetual Vows.
P-Please, anything but that...
If we fail to root out the Apostates as soon as possible, the very foundation of Celestial will be threatened.
Should that happen, you will lose the chance to even receive the vestments of Celestial.
So, I would appreciate it if you moved a bit faster.

Please give us just a little more time!
We will definitely root them out...!

We have no more time to delay.
Make sure you understand that.
...Yes.
You may leave now.

Man, that was suffocating.
Is the vibe always this intense?
It is not quite like that, but...
Regardless, thank you for accepting my invitation on such short notice.
Skip the pleasantries. What did you call me here for?
I have a hunch, but...

As you just saw...
Regrettably, it appears there is an Apostate among us.
Furthermore, she seems to be seducing other sisters one by one down the path of evil.

The problem is... while we are aware of the Apostate's presence, we have yet to identify who it is.
Moreover...
We cannot even make this public, out of fear that exposing the presence of an Apostate would negatively impact the faith of our believers.
...In short, you want me to find the Apostate hiding inside?

But is it okay for an outsider like me to help with your business?
Just to be clear, I have no intention of becoming a believer.
I had no such expectations to begin with, so do not worry.
However... I will admit that since I became Mother Superior, we have had very few proper Executioner candidates, leaving us severely understaffed.

For that reason, though I am ashamed to admit it...
I would like to borrow your help as a Fixer.
Of course, you will be rewarded handsomely.

I like that you're clear on payment.
But is there anything else?

Pardon?
What do you mean?
Money is money, but even though I'm not part of Celestial, I'm pretty interested in your worship services and system...

Even as an outsider...
I'd like to be granted access to observe the rituals, services, and such.
May I ask the reason?

Just... curiosity, let's say?
Let me just call it a bit of interest.
Unlike Feelharmony, your worship services aren't open to the public, right?

I heard that... there are even more stimulating—
no, I mean sacred rituals here that go a step beyond the usual worship.
I just want to see it for myself.
Hmm...
As you know, Celestial Cathedral is a place where only the "chosen ones" may enter according to doctrine.
The only reason you were able to step foot here today is because I granted an "exception."

Right?
Otherwise, I wouldn't have even gotten inside and would've been stopped by the guard nuns.
In accordance with Harmonix's teachings, filling the beautiful vessel of the body with devout faith is our doctrine and belief.
Which means we cannot show it to just anyone carelessly.
However...

...?
What's with that smile?

Does that not mean that while your faith has yet to bloom,
your heart has already leaned toward Celestial?

Very well.
As an exception, I shall grant you "observation rights" as a reward, Fixer.
Of course, that is... a matter for after you catch the Apostate.
...There are parts I want to nitpick, but even as Mother Superior, is it really okay for you to give out that permission so easily?
Because you are someone guided by Harmonix so Celestial may receive aid.

Well... works for me.
Though there's something I suddenly got curious about.
Yes, please go ahead.
From what I heard before, an awful punishment awaits an Apostate...
Could you tell me in detail what kind of punishment it is?

Very well.
There is no harm in explaining.
First, we tear the Apostate's clothes to shreds and make them walk through every street in Vermont.
After that, we erect a Pillory in the plaza, bind them to it, and then...
I shall leave the rest to your imagination.
Mmm... A naked parade of Apostates, huh? That'd be quite a sight.

But is that punishment actually permitted by Vermont City Hall?
Do they not arrest people for public exposure around here?
Vermont may be a city-state with separation of church and state, but even so, it is a city with a long history with the Harmonix Faith.
Public authorities have no say in events held by Celestial, an officially recognized denomination.

Complaints come in occasionally, but ignoring them is all it takes.
Is that explanation sufficient?

Yep, that answers my question.
I'll handle the commission properly, so I'm looking forward to it.

Thank you.
Well then...
Ah, let me ask just one last thing.
...What is it?

Why on earth do you wear that blindfold?
You seem to see perfectly fine even with it on.
It was a gift from the former Mother Superior, who gave me this current life of mine.
It is... something akin to my feelings for her, but let me assure you that my vision is completely blocked.

However, could we leave such extra details about me for later?
Now that you have accepted the commission, I would like to ask your opinion based on the information gathered so far.
Hmm... Yeah, fair enough. Let's do that.

chat.t: Did you leave a message?

o: I called you earlier, guess you couldn't pick up
Yeah, I think I found a lead

chat.t: That is music to my ears.

o: Get ready to be surprised
And get my money ready too

chat.t: I will be waiting.
May Harmonix's blessing be upon your vessel.

o: ...Aww, your reaction is no fun

chat.t: Thank you for helping today.
Thanks to you, the Apostate issue has been resolved... though it is a bit shocking.

o:
I didn't expect that the target of apostasy was you.
And harboring hostility toward that target on top of it?

chat.t:
It was not mere hostility.
It was explicit, intense... yet somehow subtle hostility.
But in any case, since she harbored hostility toward me, I must take some form of action... Sigh.
I have no idea how to handle the execution.

o: What are you worrying about? Just do what you usually do

chat.t:
I am not so sure... I will need to think about it.
The situation is so exceptional...

At any rate... I have transferred your payment immediately.
I will also maintain your permission to freely come and go within Celestial.

o: Yeah, see you next time then
...Don't be too troubled about it

chat.t: Yes... I will keep that in mind.

lines.t: Inside Celestial Cathedral
I was waiting for you.
I am sorry that I am the only one who came out to greet you.
Is this place usually this empty at this hour?
There was no one here last time either...

It is time for the other sisters to attend to their duties in preparation for worship.
It is only natural that there are few people around.
Besides, it would do no good for others to hear talk of an Apostate.

But is information about an Apostate really something that needs to be handled so quietly?
Can't everyone just hunt them down together?
Doing so would mean a high probability of failing to eradicate the roots of the Apostate group.
At a time when we are not even sure how many of them exist, it is difficult to hunt them down so openly.
Mmm...
So, what information have you brought?
First off, I spent some time scouting around Celestial Cathedral and the convent to keep an eye on things.

I don't have any decisive clues yet...
but I narrowed it down to a few people my gut tells me are suspicious.
Hmm... Who might they be?

With limited information, finding clear evidence beyond that is tough.
Unless they're caught in the act, that is...

Anyway, here's the data I compiled.
Take a look.
Mmm...

Couldn't you take off your blindfold at a time like this?
You can't read the documents.
I have ways to read documents without using my eyes, so it is fine.

...Well, do as you like.
I'm not the one in a rush.
But how did you gather all this information?
The information I shared with you must have been very limited...

Yeah, that limited info did tie my hands a bit.
If there were more specific characteristics of the Apostate or something, it would've been much easier to work.
If we had such information, there is no way we would have failed to catch them ourselves.
Ha, true enough.

But you know...
there's one thing I need to confirm.
What would that be?
Before I tell you, let me mention that you might have to assist me directly.
Think you can do that?

Let me hear it first.
Whatever could you possibly need...
I need the authority to interrogate one of the suspicious suspects.

...This is sudden.
An interrogation?
I found it suspicious that progress was stalled so much that you had to ask me for help.
I just figured the Apostate would need a certain degree of influence to hide their identity like this.
After all, to easily control and manage information, they have to be in a position where they can do so.
To reach a high position within Celestial, one must constantly prove their faith.
There is no way such individuals would become Apostates...
Ah, those people are out of the question to begin with.
The person I'm talking about has influence, but isn't someone that high up the ladder.
Do you have someone specific in mind?
Yes.
Who on earth...
The nun directly under you that I saw yesterday.

Not having even completed her Postulancy means she's technically a newcomer, but for the Mother Superior to command her directly and entrust her with such a big task, she couldn't possibly be just an ordinary novice.
Isn't she your star pupil or direct subordinate?

She is...
my direct secretary.
She joined Celestial quite some time ago, but she still lacks in various essential virtues such as dancing or singing...
She is a girl who has failed to progress beyond her Postulancy for a long time.
She reminded me of my past self, so I have been taking care of her personally...
Where is she right now?

While I was meeting with you, Fixer, I sent her on an errand to the forest in the city outskirts.
Incense herbs used for worship grow abundantly there.
However, I have not yet given permission for an interrogation...
Do you want to catch the Apostate or not?

...Sigh.
Very well.

But this is strictly a simple questioning.
I have yet to accept her as a suspect.
Yeah, that's good enough.
City Outskirts Forest
A moment later...
By the way, that secretary nun resembles your past self?
...She resembles me before I opened my "Mind's Eye."

Until I picked up a sword and became active as an Executioner...
I was no better than a failure unsuited to be a Celestial nun.

Had the former Mother Superior not recognized my aptitude for martial arts...
I cannot even picture what would have become of me today.

What's the Mind's Eye anyway?
Are you like a blind swordswoman?

My eyes are not blind...
Let us just say it is something akin to extrasensory perception.
Even with my eyes covered like this, I can see people's intentions.

That is why I cannot believe my secretary is an Apostate.
She harbored no intention whatsoever to betray me.
The only reason I allowed this interrogation is to prove her innocence.
...Just because you can see intentions doesn't mean you can see everything, right?

That is true.
However, I can at least see that my secretary is right over there.
May Harmonix's blessing be upon your vessel.
Did you gather the incense herbs I requested?
Of course, Mother Superior Bianca!
Enough to last us easily through next week—

Thank you, sister.
Thanks to you, this week's worship will be rich in grace.
By the way, sister?
Yes, Mother Superior?
I am certain I sent you alone...
Why are there so many corrupt souls surrounding us?
Huh? What do you...
And then...
Why are they all expressing intense "hostility" toward me?

Ehehe...
It's Bianca... Apostate(?) 1
I knew she'd come here... Apostate(?) 2
Sigh... I trusted that you would not be an Apostate, sister...
My vision was mistaken.
...No, your vision wasn't wrong!
Khg...!

Cease this futile resistance.
Now, it is time for your interrogation.

...As expected, you are so strong, Bianca.
To think we couldn't win even with this many people...

Do you not know?
I possess the "Mind's Eye."

Of course I know.
And that is why... I admire you all the more...!
After all... rather than some ambiguous god, Bianca, who possesses this overwhelming strength and overwhelming ability, is the true one!

The one closest to God...!
No, a being that could be called God herself!!!
Ahhh... I must worship you once more...!
...What a weirdo.

Well, it's not the first time I've seen people worshiping an outstanding person as a god...
but this was unexpected.

o: Hey, what you up to?

chat.t: Um...
Fixer? There is something I would like to ask you.

o: What is it?

chat.t: You suddenly requested additional compensation... What is the meaning of this?
I'm certain the payment was already...

o: Ah, that's just an excuse
Just an excuse to go out together

chat.t: I do not have time for leisure...

o: Liar
Now that the Apostate issue is settled, can't you even go on a quick date with me?
I'm hurt! So cold!

chat.t: Haah... Very well.
Only for one day.

o: Great, I'll see you at the plaza

chat.t: I am sorry for leaving so suddenly.
The date we could not finish this time... let us continue it next time.

o: Sure, it's a promise
More importantly, what are you going to do about those Apostates?

chat.t: That is... something I am deliberating.
Of course, finding them comes first before doing anything else.

lines.t: Vermont Plaza
May Harmonix's blessing be upon your vessel.

May your vessel...
Well, whatever.
Phew... I wish you had at least given a proper greeting.

Ugh, those religious greetings give me goosebumps.
Hearing them is fine, but saying them feels weird.
Fufu... Indeed, I suppose expecting that from someone who is not a believer is a bit much.
So... why did you suddenly invite me out to hang out today?

Consider it a change of pace.
Since you went through something pretty big recently, you need some rest.
I can tell your mind is still full of what happened that day.
You still haven't decided what to do with them, right?
That is true, but...
If I cannot endure even this as Mother Superior...

Always with the Mother Superior excuse.
Just forget about that title for a day and relax, will you?

How'd you become such a stiff person anyway?
Isn't Celestial supposed to be a place that worships God with much more freedom and harmony than Feelharmony?

Ah, this won't do.
First, I need to help you strip all of that away.

Outfits are important for a date...
First up, clothes shopping!
Wh-What??
Pelican Feeling Store
There are... so many people and items here.
Is this your first time at a shopping mall?

...Yes.
In truth, I rarely go out to buy things directly.

This is the Pelican Feeling Store.
It has everything—they sell whatever you can think of.
Whatever?
Yeah. If it exists, they sell it.
That is quite impressive...
Anyway... with so many people and goods, it is quite overwhelming.
With all the crowding, viewing everything with my Mind's Eye is a bit straining...
If it's that tough, why not take off that blindfold just for today?
What's this?

That's called a 'tumbler'.
You can store water or drinks inside while drinking from it.

That's a 'figure'.
It's similar to the statues in your cathedral.
What is this long thing?
Th-That is...

A 'holy tool'.
It makes the user feel good.
A holy... tool?

I do not understand.
Does that mean it is an item only Saintesses can use?
...You really know nothing about society, do you?
For someone who's the Mother Superior of Celestial, you sure seem to lack real-world experience.
...That may be true, but...
Anyway, you don't use that here—you use it when you're alone somewhere.
Or when you're with me.
...Why are you smiling so lecherously while holding that?
...It's nothing.
Anyway, the clothing section is over here.
Mm... These clothes are quite revealing.
Harmonix will be pleased.
Well, yeah, because this is the underwear section.
Underwear or not, clothing is clothing.
Oh, is that so?

Is there anything here you'd like to try on?
Or can you not see them with your Mind's Eye?

I cannot... see them.
However, I can tell the general idea.

However... wearing a habit is a nun's duty.
As Mother Superior, I must set an example.
Even if this is the date you requested as a reward, Fixer, I wonder if this is right...

Bianca.
This isn't the cathedral.

There are no doctrines, no Apostates, and no Mother Superior here.
It's just buying and selling things, and hanging out with friends.

I think these clothes would suit you, so why not try them on?
What do you say?
...Do you really think so?

Of course!
So try them on, quick.
By the way, the fitting room is—

Over there, then.
Understood.

I-I am trying this on just this once!
Got it?!
You sure do a lot for me while claiming it's "just this once."
Hurry up and go try them on.
...Alright, almost time.
No way she'd keep the blindfold on while changing clothes, right?
Vermont Plaza
You truly are an unpredictable person.
Fickle and spontaneous, yet systematic and methodical...
That's just how I am.
By the way, you're surprisingly full of emotion when your blindfold is off.
You're pretty dry when you have it on.

I-I was just surprised because you barged in all of a sudden...
It is nothing more, nothing less.
...By the way, do you pull pranks like this on others as well?

I don't pull pranks like this on just anyone.
Ah, that was fun!

Fun?!
You insulted the Mother Superior of Celestial and every Executioner!
Come on, like I said earlier, today is a day off to shake off all that heavy pressure for just one day.
According to Celestial doctrine, physical pleasures aren't impure either, so there's no way the joy of relaxing is a sin.

That is far too self-serving an interpretation...
Haah.

*Gasp, gasp, gasp*... Here you were.
Bianca!
What is the matter?
The Apostates we captured recently, they all escaped!!
{player}, Fixer, I am afraid we must cut today's date short.
...That's a shame.
If I end up needing help, I will contact you right away.
May Harmonix's blessing be upon your vessel.

chat.t: {player}, hello, Fixer.

o: Yeah, has there been any progress since then?

chat.t: ...We have not caught the Apostates yet.
We are continuing to track them, but perhaps because they know our methods, they keep slipping away.

o: To be honest, whether you catch them or not doesn't really matter to me, but
If you need help, why not hire me again?

chat.t: I shall. However, there is something even more important than that.
My Mind's Eye... seems strange these days.
It reads competitiveness as hostility, curiosity as suspicion...
And there is a bigger problem than that...

o: Well, if it's something I can help with, I will, but...
What do I need to do?

chat.t: Let us meet first.
Um...
Fixer. There is something I would like to ask.

o: ? What is it

chat.t: Our next date... when can we schedule it?
I was curious, so I asked.

o: ...So suddenly??

chat.t: So, what is your answer?

o: ...As soon as possible?
Wait, weren't you in a rush because of the Apostates?

chat.t: ...That... I decided to get help from the other nuns.
The things you said today, Fixer... resonated with me.
So, what is your answer?

o: ...Soon?

chat.t: I shall go sharpen my blade.

o: Alright, alright! You acting like this out of nowhere is throwing me off!!

lines.t: Inside Celestial Cathedral
May Harmonix's blessing be upon your vessel.

That greeting makes me blush every time I hear it.
I definitely can't bring myself to say it.
Fufu, I was not particularly expecting you to.
Look at you making jokes now. You've grown.
So, how should I help you?
Well...
As I mentioned earlier, my Mind's Eye has been a bit strange lately.
Originally, I could see everything from people's subtle intentions to surrounding objects with my Mind's Eye...
Lately, it only comes across as something hazy and abstract.
I do not know if it is due to the shock of the Apostate incident or something else, but...
...No, and even before that...

Why are you beating around the bush like this? It's not like you.
Get to the point, the point.
It is something I have found slightly puzzling for a while.
To be sure, part of it was that your power was so faint I did not pay attention to it, but...
Lately, I cannot see your intentions with my Mind's Eye at all, Fixer.

...Lately? Since when?
And... is that even a problem in the first place?

Because it means something has gone wrong with my Mind's Eye regardless.
I want to resolve it.

As for when it started... well.
It seems to be when you suddenly barged in while I was changing clothes last time.
...Just so you know, I didn't do anything except walk in?!

I know.
I am not suspecting you of having done anything in particular.

This is undoubtedly a psychological issue of my own.
However, since I have no idea what kind of problem it is...
...So basically, spend some time together until you can see my intentions again while practicing to regain control of your Mind's Eye... or something like that?

Yes.
As expected, you are sharp.

In the end, this is all due to my lack of training.
If I travel with you, whose intentions I cannot see, and train myself to deal with various variables...
Might it not return to normal eventually?
I don't know what gives you that confidence, but I can go along with that much.

Alright, I'm in a good mood. I'll do this for free.
We can just think of it as a continuation of our last date.

...Is that really alright?
You are spending your time to help me, after all...
Don't get the wrong idea. I'm only agreeing because I don't mind hanging out with you.

And while the more money the better, I still have cash left over from the last payment.
I'm not that hard up.

Hm...
Understood.
Then, what shall we do first?
Vermont Street

This is bread.
But why bread all of a sudden...

To be precise, it's campagne.
The very bread that got me locked up in Panoticon.

You were locked in that luxurious...
No, notorious prison, just over a piece of bread?
Hah... It's a long story.
Excuse me, but why are people staring at me with such shocked expressions?

There are two reasons.
One, your revealing figure is on full display.

That is always the case.
What is the second?
Second, I'm currently trying to tuck a baguette between the lower parts of your breasts.

You really can't read my intentions, huh?
This is fun.
Haah... Honestly, you are quite the mischievous troublemaker.
Please give some thought to my dignity as Mother Superior of Celestial...

Nope.
This way is much more fun.
Besides, you only need to keep up your dignity inside the cathedral, I told you.
Ugh...
A movie theater in Vermont
A movie theater for someone wearing a blindfold...
You are truly trying your hardest to make me uncover my face.

Suit yourself.
There are ways to enjoy it with just the sound and atmosphere.
Of course, you'll miss out on all the visual beauty intended by the director.

...Ah, though they say there's something called 4D movies these days.
The seats move, spray water, burn incense...

Ngh...!
Suddenly something between my thighs...!?

Ah, that's part of the movie too.
Something about a device made with tentacle magic or whatever...

T-Tentacles?
No matter how I think about it, this sensation feels like a hand...

Uh-uh.
If you want to check, take off your blindfold.

I-I cannot do that.
I must endure in this state somehow to regain control of my Mind's Eye...
Besides, without my blindfold, my dignity as an Executioner diminishes.

What dignity in a place like this?
Hold back your moans before saying stuff like that.

Hngh...!
Something warm, further up...!
Two hours later...
*Gasp... gasp...*

T-Tentacles were dangerous things after all.
To push me this far...
...Though tentacles seemed to have nothing to do with the movie, why did 4D work in such a way...

Ah, don't worry about that.
Well, movies like that exist.

Now then, I'm heading to the bathroom for a sec.
I need to wash my hands.
Ah, spraying water on only me is just too much...!
After spending a fulfilling day like that...
Phew, today's date was fun.

I enjoyed it too.
Except for the part where you constantly teased me to make me take off my blindfold.
So the rumor that you were arrested for being a pervert was true after all.
I'll tell you again, my clothes just got burnt off when I fell from the sky!
It's not like I'm facing execution or anything, and I don't have a hobby of walking around naked in the streets.
Besides, I was merely helping your training by testing your composure.

Even without my Mind's Eye, it is crystal clear that your mind is filled with dirty thoughts.
You truly are a pervert.

Let's put that pervert talk aside for a moment.
It's not like you really resisted either, right?
In the first place, nobody around here treats you this casually, so you asked for this "training" knowing full well I'd act like this, didn't you?

...As expected of you, Fixer.
You are sharp.

That is right. Within Celestial, I am the Mother Superior and Executioner.
An existence that is always solitary, dignified, and difficult to approach.

I have no one I can call a confidant...
And the previous Mother Superior, who was my spiritual pillar, is no longer with us.

Even the scribe, who seemed to share a similar past with me...
ended up like that as well.

But it cannot be helped, can it?
When you hold such a position... you must act fittingly for it.
...So, that's why you've started doubting your Mind's Eye?
...Excuse me?
If blind faith in your Mind's Eye was your problem before, now it seems doubting it is the issue.
Betrayed by someone you trusted, losing confidence in yourself.
From where I stand, that's exactly what your situation looks like.
I don't know what the previous Mother Superior expected of you or wished for when appointing you to that position, but...
Anyone can make mistakes, and anyone can do something wrong.
You might lead someone down the wrong path, or you might fail to solve a problem properly.
However...
The way I see it, those apostates aren't all that different from you.
You're always busy bringing up the previous Mother Superior and idolizing her at every turn yourself, anyway.
Isn't the previous Mother Superior, who felt close to your heart, more precious to you than Harmonix, who feels so far away?
Besides, what those guys said back then... I don't think it's very appropriate phrasing for religious folk, but it sounded a lot like a meme that was popular where I used to live.
Rather than seeing you as a literal god, there's a good chance they're just super fans of yours, you know?

If you train and guide them properly...
who knows if they might become fine believers or Executioners someday?
Just like you did.
...I see.

I only viewed the world through the Mind's Eye...
and never truly looked at this world properly.

...I shall take my leave for today.
I have much to think about.
Uh, yeah. Right.

Sigh.
She really is a handful for a Mother Superior.

chat.t:
Fixer. I have pinpointed the location of the possible apostates.
It seems I will be able to face my scribe again very soon.

o: So you finally found them. Have you decided whether to execute them?

chat.t: ...That will depend on their answer.
I am not being swayed by personal feelings, but given the circumstances, I am not so heartless as to deny them even a chance to explain.

o: So, why are you telling me this?

chat.t: Must I really explain it in my own words?

o: I woke up and you weren't there. Did you leave early?

chat.t: Ah, yes. Thanks to you staying with me last night, Fixer, my mind feels clear again.

It had been nothing but chaotic and confusing events lately...
so I ended up relying on you quite a lot...

o: I knew it, this was your real personality all along, wasn't it?

chat.t: W-What are you talking about?

o: Stop pretending to be cool and composed all the time, it doesn't suit you

That said, don't rely on me too much either
It's not like I can do everything for you

chat.t: ...Yes.
Still, my Mind's Eye is functioning properly again, so I will be fine!

o: Alright, that's good then

chat.t: By the way, Fixer. I have one more favor to ask.

o: Huh? What is it?

chat.t: Well, if you have time tonight as well...
Could you spend one more night with me...?

o: What are you a succubus?

lines.t: Inside Celestial Cathedral
May Harmonix's blessing be upon your vessel.

Uh, sure.
So, where are those guys you mentioned?

They are said to be roaming the forests in the outskirts of the city where they were caught last time...
so we should head back there.

Is there any reason I really have to go?
My contract ended, so I'm an outsider to this now.
You were the one who stirred my heart and pointed out that this incident was a special case, Fixer.
Shouldn't you naturally take responsibility for that?

Alright, alright.
Lead the way and I'll follow.
Ever since she became strangely proactive, things haven't been easy.
City Outskirts Forest
By the way, does this forest have any connection to Celestial?

Between that incense from before and those guys sticking around here...
I can't help but feel there's been some kind of connection all along.
...Back when I was still a novice, I lived in a small cabin located here.

No, living there is not quite the right expression.
"I stayed there for ascetic training..." is closer to the truth.
So it's a place full of memories, huh?

Memories...
That is not wrong.
Rather than noisy and crowded places, a quiet spot like this where one can immerse oneself in meditation is closer to my preference.

Both Celestial and Feelharmony are noisy, but isn't Celestial worse between the two?
Considering your personality, Feelharmony would be more...
You say the exact same thing as a fellow initiate who joined the Harmonix Faith around the same time as me.
Amusingly, that friend went to Feelharmony, despite displaying traits far more suited for Celestial.
However, faith is a separate matter from personal taste or inclination.
To me, the sacredness of the physical body taught by Celestial resonated as a deeper truth.
Inside Celestial, there were also types like the Ascetics...

The Ascetics...
Sigh, I wish to explain, but that would be far too long a story.
In any case, it seems we have a welcoming party.
Even in a situation no different from apostasy, you still maintain Celestial's greetings.
Of course, Mother Superior Bianca!
During our days in the Repentance Cave, we trained our bodies... and endlessly wondered where we went wrong, and why we couldn't win your heart, Bianca!!

Save the useless chatter for later.
So, what is your conclusion?

The conclusion we reached...
As expected, Mother Superior Bianca is the true god!

...
I knew it, apostasy -

However! A human becoming a god belongs to the realm of miracles!
That, too, is God's teaching, God's guidance!

Therefore!
Harmonix, whom you serve and so firmly believe in and follow!!
Is the supreme dignity of this world, the Creator God, and the pinnacle of all creation!!

Hey, don't look at me.
That goes way beyond regular madness.
It was so much easier when they were just outright apostates or not...

Ah, O Harmonix...
Why do you grant me such trials...?
Therefore! Bound, executed, or whatever punishment we receive! We have resolved to follow only you, Bianca, and become your personal hands and feet!
We are so sorry for taking up so much time to reach this decision!!!
Haaah...

Alright.
I get it, so... return to the Repentance Cave for now.

But before that, let me ask one thing.
Why on earth did you break out and come all the way here?
It was something like a holy pilgrimage.
Huh?
This is the very place where you awakened as a demigod, Bianca!
The place where you trained your sword skill and body, awakening as the most powerful, exalted being in the world!
That is why, as soon as we gained new enlightenment, we came running here in one single bound—
Seriously, what am I supposed to do with them...

Isn't this a good thing?
You just gained subordinates who'll move like your own hands and feet.
At this rate, working them hard to turn them into Executioners—or leading them as their commander—shouldn't be too hard.
You girls, take that one and head back to the Repentance Cave.

I will inform you later about what will be done with you.
Understood?
Yes!!

My head is spinning...
I need to rest a bit.

...Honestly, even I'd get dizzy from this.
Hahaha...
By the way, is there anywhere to rest around here?

The cabin I used to use...
Let's head over there for now.

You said it's a cabin you used long ago, right?
Are you sure it's still standing?

It holds memories for me, so I periodically returned to repair and maintain it.
It should be intact.

...Right, sure.
Then I'll just head back...
Where do you think you are going?
Huh? The job is done, so shouldn't I be free to head back now?

Are you really going to leave me all alone in this forest?
I didn't expect this... You are quite cold-hearted, Fixer.
Ughhh...
Right now, I really do not want to go to the monastery or the cathedral...
So please, spare a little bit of your time for me.
How about it, <:player>...?
...Would you stay with me?
...Ah, I really have no choice here!!
